_provenance.ruling: SITTING §P.2-29 — cure 1 changes the recorder's own coordinate on the player face; a declared INSTRUMENT shift, re-recorded by the recorder before SEAM car 3a pins `pieces` against it.
_provenance.note: The economy desk is now called by its shipped recipe with every caller reading and `playerView` from the audience (scripts/prose-rate-corpus.mjs `economyDeskOptions`). Before it, 309 player cells carried `index: -1` and DM-only prose, the two faces were identical by construction on 16.3 % of cells, and two registered economy mounts recorded nothing. `recordedOverSha` is DECLARATIVE — a recorder cannot know the sha of the commit it is about to land in — and `recorder` is the executable half: the bytes of the three files that decide what this fixture says.
